book.name: 1 YONI
book.title: YONI ꞌINA ꞌETOLADI ꞌEBWEUNA Yoni ꞌina leta gete solanaya ꞌiemwasala oboboma be maedana be yawasi ataya Yesu ꞌenega manudi.

content: Keliso tauna ꞌada tolema
Ye natugwao, ꞌimi leta gete yaꞌetoladinawa be ꞌenega geyaꞌabo waguiguinuwa gesi. Ta ꞌeguma taloegesi, Yesu Keliso tauna topalupaluna ꞌisisida manuda, Tamana ꞌenaya,
be ꞌida toꞌumalinao ꞌinuwataudi, manuna Yesu tauna ꞌitaliyaena ꞌida toꞌumalinao manudi, be wate me baleꞌu maiboꞌadi manudi.
Yaubada nina tamwalatonina ꞌaene gosiya ꞌaiꞌailida, ꞌeguma ꞌina loinao taematamatanedi.
ꞌEnega ꞌeguma yaita ꞌionaona be ꞌigwae, “ꞌAboꞌagu Yaubada gosiyagu,” ta Yaubada ꞌina loinao nigeya ꞌida ematamatanedi, nate ꞌikabokabo, manuna ꞌeda palupaluna ꞌipilisinena.
Ta ꞌabo Yaubada ꞌina ona tamulimuliye, ꞌina oboboma ꞌenega ꞌiloemaeda be tamwalamwalatoni ꞌaene gosedai nina maꞌeda tamiyami.
ꞌEnega ꞌeguma yaita ꞌoyo ꞌugwae, “ꞌAboꞌagu Yaubada gosiyagu ta maꞌiyagu ꞌamiyami,” ꞌilobwene ꞌaiꞌailiyo be ꞌuda bubuna nadigega Yesu ꞌina bubuna.
Loina auwauna
Gosegwao, geyaꞌabo loina auwauna yaꞌetoꞌetoladinawa, ta esi loina kadekadelina nina wagimi nononaya, ga niꞌatu wamwalatonina, gete yalolimenawa.

Ta esi loina gete yaꞌetoladi limena ꞌatuwa loina auwauna, oboboma manuna, manuna oboboma nina Keliso ꞌana lobwene, ta ꞌomi ꞌami lobwene wate. Nate ꞌenega guguyoi ꞌisawasawala, ta maedana ꞌaiꞌaila niꞌatu ꞌisaema.
ꞌEnega ꞌeguma yaita tasina ꞌietalauwale be ꞌionaona ꞌaene tauna maedana ꞌena ꞌimiyami, nate ꞌikabokabo, manuna tauna ꞌetamo tuga guguyoi ꞌena ꞌimiyami.
Ta wate ꞌabo yaita ꞌoyo gosemwao ꞌuobobomedi, ꞌoyo maedana ꞌena ꞌumiyami, ꞌenega geyaꞌabo ꞌubeꞌubeꞌu.
Ta esi ꞌabo tasiyo ꞌuetalauwale, ꞌalena gete manuna ꞌoyo ꞌetamo guguyoi ꞌina sena ꞌena ꞌumiyami, ta wate guguyoi ꞌena ꞌutautauya, be ꞌeda geyaꞌabo ꞌuꞌitaꞌita, manuna matayo guguyoi ꞌiumabodena.
Gogama ye, ona gete yaꞌetoladinawa manuna ꞌimi loegesiyao Yaubada ꞌinuwataudi, Yesu ꞌana esanega.

ꞌEnaꞌiyao ye, ona gete yaꞌetoladinawa manuna ꞌomi tauna lowaenei ga batuwa ꞌimiyami niꞌatu wamwalamwalatoni. Tubuwauyao ye, ona gete yaꞌetoladinawa, manuna tauna totoꞌumalina sana niꞌatu waewaiwai sinena. Ta ꞌomi gogama sinasinabwami ona gete yaꞌetoladinawa, manuna Tamada niꞌatu wamwalatonina.

ꞌEnaꞌiyao ye, ona gete yaꞌetoladinawa manuna ꞌomi tauna lowaenei ga batuwa ꞌimiyami niꞌatu wamwalamwalatoni. Tubuwauyao ye, ona gete yaꞌetoladinawa, manuna ꞌomi toewaiwai sami ga Yaubada ꞌina ona ꞌimiyami ꞌemiya, ꞌenega tauna totoꞌumalina sana niꞌatu waewaiwai sinena.
Gosegwao, geyaꞌabo baleꞌu gete nuwami ꞌiꞌewaꞌewa, manuna ꞌeguma baleꞌu gwegwenao nuwami ꞌiꞌewai, gete ꞌenega Tamadai wanuwa pupule, ta nigeya wada obobomena.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, baleꞌu yagenao maiboꞌana, nate yalakwaiya be gwegwe ꞌana yala be nuwatuꞌe, yage getedi nigeya Tamada ꞌenega simeemai, ta esi baleꞌu ꞌenega.
Ta baleꞌu gete ꞌiabe ꞌisasawala ta wate nuwanuwa gwegwe baleꞌu manuna ꞌigugumwala, ta ꞌaboꞌada esi ꞌeguma Yaubada ꞌina nuwanuwa taguiguinuwe tamiya ataya.
Keliso ꞌana talauwala nina

Natugwao, tuta ꞌana ꞌebe losalowa niꞌatu ꞌimai saba, ta lowa wanonona ꞌaene Keliso ꞌana talauwala nina ꞌiabe ꞌiapwesama, ꞌenega wada nuwaꞌiꞌisi Keliso ꞌana talauwalao yaudi baleꞌuya simiyami, ꞌenega tamwalamwalatoni tuta ꞌana ꞌebe losalowa gete,
ta Keliso ꞌana talauwalao nidi ꞌadi ꞌita ꞌatuwa Keliso ꞌana toemisao, ta nigeya. Manuna taudi ꞌeguma ꞌida boda ꞌaiꞌaila, ꞌetamo maꞌedao tamiyami. Ta nigeya saꞌi! Niꞌatu sipilisineda.
Ta ꞌomi taudi nigeya nadigega, manuna niꞌatu Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌigiesinapumi, ga ꞌenega mwalatoi yauna wasinapudi,
ta nigeya ꞌaene ma imi emwagemwage ꞌimi leta gete wasawasawai, manuna eꞌita palupaluna niꞌatu wamwalatonina, ta wate wasinapuna ꞌaene nigeya wate ꞌebweu kabo ꞌiapweapwesama bubuna palupaluna ꞌenega.
Ta taudi tokabo nidi Yesu sieyaseyaseye, ta sigwae, “Yesu tauna nigeya Toꞌetoseyana.” ꞌAbo yaisigedi sionaona nadigega, taudi Keliso ꞌana talauwalao, manuna Keliso maTamana siguitoyasedi.
ꞌEnega ꞌeguma yaita ꞌoyo Yaubada Natuna ꞌuguitoyasena, nigeya Yaubada maꞌiyayo wamiyami. Ta esi ꞌeguma ꞌutagwaleyo Natuna ꞌenaya, tauna be Tamana maꞌemwao wamiyami.
ꞌOmi lowa tetelidi wanonona, ꞌenega ꞌabo tetela nina ꞌemiya ꞌimiyami tauna be Tamana maꞌemiyao wamiyami,
be yawasida nina ꞌiona upaupaenaya ꞌida ꞌebwaꞌemi, nate yawasi ataya.
Gete maiboꞌana niꞌatu yaꞌetoladinawa be ꞌaene wada sinapu taudi ꞌami tokaboyao manudi.

Ta mwalatoi nina niꞌatu wamwalatonina, manuna Yaubada Yaluyaluwana niꞌatu ꞌiꞌebwaꞌemi, ga maꞌemi wamiyami, ta ꞌieꞌitemi. ꞌEnega nigeya ꞌebweu wate tai sawesawenaya be ꞌieꞌitami, ta esi Yaubada ꞌina ꞌebwaya ꞌenega mwalatoi yauna wasinapuna, nate mwalatoi ꞌaiꞌaila manuna. Yaubada Yaluyaluwana nigeya sawesawenaya be ꞌikaboeda. ꞌEnega ꞌina eꞌitao wamuliyedi, be Keliso maꞌemi wamiyami, ta geyaꞌabo wapilipilisine.
Yaubada Natunao manudi
ꞌEnega natugwao, ꞌilobwenemi be Keliso ꞌena wamiya ataya, ꞌenega ꞌabo tuta nina ꞌiapwesama, geyaꞌabo ma imi matauta, nai ma imi omayamaya, ta esi wada gwausowala ꞌina mai manuna.
Ta Yaubada wate wada mwalatoni ꞌaene tauna Topalupaluna, ꞌenega ꞌabo yaisigedi taudi siguinuwa palupaluna, taudi Yaubada ꞌenega situbuwama.
